questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ ụdaume n'asụsụ Igbo?
options: Ụda a na-akpọpụta site na mgbochi ikuku n'ọnụ
Ụda a na-akpọpụta n'enweghị mgbochi n'ọnụ mgbe a na-ekwu ya
questions.explanation: Vowels (ụdaume) in Igbo are speech sounds produced without significant obstruction of airflow, distinguishing them from consonants (mgbochiume), which involve some closure or narrowing in the vocal tract.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ mgbochiume n'asụsụ Igbo?
options: Ụda a na-akpọpụta n'enweghị mgbochi ọ bụla
Ụda a na-akpọpụta site na mgbochi ikuku n'otu ebe n'ọnụ
questions.explanation: Consonants (mgbochiume) are produced by partially or fully obstructing airflow at some point in the vocal tract, unlike the more open articulation of vowels.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Ụdaume ole ka a na-akọwa na ha dị n'asụsụ Igbo izugbe?
questions.explanation: Standard Igbo is generally described as having eight vowel sounds, organised into two harmonic sets used in the phonological process known as vowel harmony.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ ụda ọnụ na-esite n'imi apụta, dịka 'm' na 'n' mgbe ha na-arụ ọrụ dịka ụdaume?
options: Mgbochiume nsi-imi na-arụ ọrụ dịka mkpụrụedemede (syllabic nasals)
questions.explanation: In Igbo, the nasal consonants m and n can function as syllabic nasals, forming a complete syllable on their own without an accompanying vowel, a notable feature of Igbo phonology.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ usoro nke ụdaume n'otu okwu na-akwado ibe ha dịka otu ụdị (ndakọrịta ụdaume)?
questions.explanation: Vowel harmony (ndakọrịta ụdaume) is a phonological rule requiring vowels within a word to belong to the same harmonic set, a defining feature of Igbo phonology.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ akara e ji egosi ọdịda na ọrịgo olu n'okwu Igbo?
questions.explanation: Tone marks (akara olu) indicate the pitch pattern (high, low, or downstepped) of syllables in written Igbo, an essential feature since tone can distinguish word meaning.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Olu ole bụ isi ka a na-akọwa na ha dị n'asụsụ Igbo?
options: Olu elu na olu ala (high and low tone, plus a downstep variant)
questions.explanation: Igbo phonology is fundamentally built around high and low tones, with a downstepped high tone also recognised, forming the basic tonal system used to distinguish word meanings.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ mpaghara okwu nke nwere ụdaume otu mgbe a na-akpọ ya?
questions.explanation: A syllable (mkpụrụedemede) is a unit of pronunciation typically built around a single vowel sound, which may be preceded by one or more consonants.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ usoro nke otu ụda na-agbanwe ka o yie ụda ọzọ dị n'akụkụ ya n'okwu?
questions.explanation: Assimilation refers to a phonological process where a sound changes to become more similar to a neighbouring sound within the same word, a recognised pattern in Igbo phonology.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: N'ụtọasụsụ Igbo, mkpụrụedemede dị mfe (open syllable) na-adịkarị site na
options: mgbochiume gbara ụdaume aka (CV), na-akwụsị na ụdaume
mgbochiume abụọ na-esote ibe ha na enweghị ụdaume
questions.explanation: An open syllable in Igbo commonly follows a consonant-vowel (CV) pattern, ending in the vowel sound rather than a consonant.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Ọ bụ olee ihe a na-akpọ mmụta gbasara ụda okwu na otu e si edozi ha n'asụsụ?
options: Ụdaasụsụ na Usoro Ụdaasụsụ (phonetics and phonology)
questions.explanation: Phonetics and phonology (Ụdaasụsụ na Usoro Ụdaasụsụ) is the branch of language study focused on the sounds of a language and how those sounds are systematically organised.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu uru mmụta banyere ụdaume na mgbochiume bara na mmụta asụsụ Igbo?
options: Ọ na-enyere aka naanị na akụkọ ifo
Ọ na-enyere mmadụ aka ịkọwapụta okwu nke ọma na ịmata otu e si akpọ ya
Ọ bara uru naanị na mgbako
questions.explanation: Understanding vowels and consonants helps learners correctly analyse and pronounce words accurately, a foundational skill for effective communication in Igbo.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu usoro mkpụrụedemede a na-eji ede asụsụ Igbo n'oge a?
questions.explanation: The Onwu orthography, adopted in 1961, is the officially standardised writing system currently used for the Igbo language, replacing earlier competing systems.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ mkpụrụedemede abụọ e jikọtara ọnụ iji gosipụta otu ụda, dịka 'gb' ma ọ bụ 'kp'?
questions.explanation: Digraphs are combinations of two letters representing a single distinct sound, such as 'gb' or 'kp', which are common consonant clusters in the Igbo alphabet.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe kacha mkpa e ji edobe usoro mkpụrụedemede kwesịrị ekwesị n'ederede Igbo?
options: Ka mkpụrụokwu niile bụrụ otu ogologo
Ka ọ bụrụ na e nwee nhazi na nghọta n'etiti ndị na-eji asụsụ ahụ
Ka a kwụsị iji ụdaume ọ bụla
Ka a hapụ iji akara olu ọ bụla
questions.explanation: Maintaining consistent orthographic standards ensures clarity, consistency, and mutual understanding among all users of written Igbo.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ mkpụrụokwu e siri n'asụsụ ọzọ bata n'asụsụ Igbo, dịka okwu e siri na Bekee bata?
questions.explanation: Loan words (mkpụrụokwu e ji) are terms borrowed from another language, such as English, and incorporated into Igbo vocabulary.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ usoro nke e si esite na okwu abụọ dị iche iche mepụta otu okwu ọhụrụ (blending)?
questions.explanation: Blending is a word-formation process where parts of two separate words are combined to create a new word, one of the ways new vocabulary emerges in Igbo.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ usoro nke e si emepụta okwu ọhụrụ kpamkpam n'asụsụ Igbo iji kwado echiche ọhụrụ?
questions.explanation: Word coinage refers to the deliberate creation of entirely new words, often to express new concepts or ideas not previously captured by existing Igbo vocabulary.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Olee ihe kpatara e ji na-ewepụta usoro mkpụrụedemede izugbe n'asụsụ dịka Igbo?
options: Iji mee ka okwu ghara ịpụta ìhè
Iji hụ na e nwere otu ụzọ e si ede okwu n'akwụkwọ na akụkọ
Iji gbochie ndị mmadụ ịmụ asụsụ ahụ
questions.explanation: A standardised orthography ensures consistent spelling and writing conventions across books, newspapers, and other written materials, avoiding confusion among readers.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ mkpụrụokwu dị iche iche a na-eji akọwa otu ihe n'ụzọ dị iche na mpaghara dị iche iche (dialectal variation)?
questions.explanation: Dialect words reflect regional variation in vocabulary used to describe the same concept differently across various Igbo-speaking communities, a natural feature of any widely spoken language.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu isi ihe ndị a na-agbaso mgbe a na-esupe okwu n'asụsụ Igbo kwesịrị ekwesị?
options: Iji akara olu ziri ezi na mkpụrụedemede kwesịrị ekwesị dịka usoro Onwu si kwuo
questions.explanation: Correct Igbo spelling requires using the appropriate letters and tone marks in accordance with the standardised Onwu orthography rules.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ ọnụọgụ mkpụrụedemede niile e ji ede asụsụ Igbo n'usoro Onwu?
options: Ọ dị iri mkpụrụedemede na ise (36 letters, gụnyere mgbochiume abụọ jikọrọ ọnụ)
questions.explanation: The standard Igbo (Onwu) alphabet consists of 36 letters, including several digraphs (like gb, gh, kp, nw, ny) representing sounds not found in a simple Latin script.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ okwu na-akọwa aha mmadụ, ebe, ma ọ bụ ihe n'asụsụ Igbo?
questions.explanation: A noun (mkpọaha) is a word class used to name a person, place, thing, or idea, forming a fundamental word category in Igbo grammar.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ okwu na-egosi omume ma ọ bụ mmegharị ahụ n'asụsụ Igbo, dịka 'gaa' ma ọ bụ 'rie'?
questions.explanation: A verb (ngwaa) expresses an action or occurrence, such as 'gaa' (go) or 'rie' (eat), forming the core predicate of an Igbo sentence.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ okwu na-akọwa àdị mkpọaha n'asụsụ Igbo, dịka 'ọma' ma ọ bụ 'ọjọọ'?
questions.explanation: An adjective (nkọwa) describes or modifies a noun by attributing a quality to it, such as 'ọma' (good) or 'ọjọọ' (bad).

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ okwu na-akọwa ngwaa, nkọwa, ma ọ bụ nkwuwa ọzọ n'asụsụ Igbo?
questions.explanation: An adverb (nkwuwa) modifies a verb, adjective, or another adverb, typically indicating manner, time, or degree.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ mgbakwunye e ji na-agbanwe ma ọ bụ kwado ma ọ bụ nsonye okwu, dịka mgbakwunye ihu ma ọ bụ mgbakwunye azụ?
questions.explanation: An affix (mgbakwunye okwu) is a morphological element attached to a root word, either at the beginning (prefix) or end (suffix), modifying its meaning or grammatical function.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ okwu na-ejikọta okwu abụọ ma ọ bụ ahịrịokwu abụọ ọnụ, dịka 'na' ma ọ bụ 'ma ọ bụ'?
questions.explanation: A conjunction (njikọ okwu) links words, phrases, or clauses, such as 'na' (and) or 'ma ọ bụ' (or), showing the relationship between the connected elements.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ okwu na-egosi ọnọdụ ihe metụtara ihe ọzọ, dịka 'n'elu' ma ọ bụ 'n'okpuru'?
questions.explanation: A preposition (mbuuzo) indicates the relationship, often of place or time, between a noun and another element in the sentence, such as 'n'elu' (on top of) or 'n'okpuru' (under).

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ ahịrịokwu zuru oke nke nwere onye ma ọ bụ ihe na-eme ihe (subject) na ihe a na-eme (predicate)?
questions.explanation: A complete sentence (ahịrịokwu) in Igbo grammar consists of a subject (the doer or topic) and a predicate (what is said about the subject), forming a grammatically complete statement.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ahịrịokwu a na-akpọ ahịrịokwu dị mfe (simple sentence) n'asụsụ Igbo?
options: Ahịrịokwu nwere naanị otu onye/ihe na-eme na otu omume
Ahịrịokwu nwere ahịrịokwu abụọ jikọrọ ọnụ site na njikọ okwu
questions.explanation: A simple sentence expresses one complete idea with a single subject and predicate, without combining multiple clauses.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ ahịrịokwu abụọ ma ọ bụ karịa jikọrọ ọnụ site na njikọ okwu dịka 'na' ma ọ bụ 'mana'?
questions.explanation: A compound sentence joins two or more independent clauses using a conjunction such as 'na' (and) or 'mana' (but).

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ ahịrịokwu na-enye iwu ma ọ bụ arịrịọ, dịka 'Gaa ụlọ akwụkwọ!'?
questions.explanation: An imperative sentence issues a command or request, such as 'Gaa ụlọ akwụkwọ!' (Go to school!).

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu isi mmụta na-elebara anya n'otu e si ahazi okwu na ahịrịokwu iji mepụta ahịrịokwu ziri ezi?
questions.explanation: Grammar (ụtọasụsụ) is the area of language study concerned with how words are correctly combined and arranged to form grammatically sound sentences.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ okwu na-anọchi anya mkpọaha n'ahịrịokwu, dịka 'ọ' ma ọ bụ 'ha'?
questions.explanation: A pronoun (nnochi aha) stands in place of a noun, such as 'ọ' (he/she/it) or 'ha' (they), avoiding repetition of the noun itself.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu isi akụkụ nke ụtọasụsụ Igbo na-elebara anya n'ọnọdụ okwu n'ahịrịokwu (dịka onye ọrụ, ihe a na-arụ ọrụ na ya)?
questions.explanation: Syntax specifically examines how words function and are positioned within a sentence (such as subject, verb, and object roles), a subset of the broader study of grammar.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Mgbe a na-agụ otu edemede iji ghọta ya (comprehension), gịnị ka a na-achọ n'aka onye na-agụ ya?
options: Ka ọ bụrụ na ọ chọghị ịza ajụjụ ọ bụla
Ka ọ chepụta akụkọ ọhụrụ zuru oke
Ka ọ tụgharịa edemede ahụ gaa n'asụsụ Bekee
Ka ọ ghọta isi ihe na nkọwa dị n'edemede ahụ ma zaa ajụjụ ndị metụtara ya
questions.explanation: Comprehension exercises require the reader to understand the meaning and details of a passage and accurately answer related questions.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ụdị edemede a na-akpọ nke na-akọ akụkọ n'usoro (narrative essay)?
questions.explanation: A narrative essay tells a story or recounts a sequence of events, typically following a clear chronological structure from beginning to end.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ụdị edemede a na-akpọ nke na-akọwapụta ihe ma ọ bụ ọnọdụ n'ụzọ zuru ezu (descriptive essay)?
questions.explanation: A descriptive essay vividly describes a person, place, object, or situation, using detailed language to create a clear mental image for the reader.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ụdị edemede a na-akpọ nke na-egosipụta echiche onye edemede na iji ihe akaebe kwado ya (argumentative essay)?
questions.explanation: An argumentative essay presents a clear position or opinion on a topic, supporting it with logical reasoning and evidence, often addressing counterarguments.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: N'ide akwụkwọ ozi n'asụsụ Igbo, gịnị ka a na-ejikarị amalite akwụkwọ ozi ahụ?
options: Ekele na aha onye a na-edegara akwụkwọ ozi ahụ
questions.explanation: Igbo letters typically begin with an appropriate greeting and address to the recipient, establishing the tone and context before the main content.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Mgbe a na-agụ otu edemede nwere ọtụtụ okwu (dịka okwu 150), gịnị bụ isi ihe a na-achọ ịmata?
options: Isi ozi na nkọwa dị n'ime edemede ahụ
Ụbọchị e dere edemede ahụ naanị
Aha onye dere edemede ahụ naanị
Ọnụọgụgụ mkpụrụokwu dị n'ime ya kpọmkwem
questions.explanation: The primary goal of reading a comprehension passage is to grasp its central message and supporting details, not merely to count words or note superficial facts.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu nkà a na-achọkarị n'aka nwata na-ede edemede zuru oke n'asụsụ Igbo?
options: Ide n'enweghị akara olu ọ bụla n'ihe ọ bụla
Nhazi echiche n'usoro doro anya na iji ụtọasụsụ ziri ezi
questions.explanation: Effective essay writing requires organising ideas in a clear, logical sequence while applying correct grammar and language usage.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ nkọwa nkenke nke isi ihe dị n'otu edemede (summary)?
questions.explanation: A summary (nchịkọta) is a brief statement capturing the essential main points of a longer passage, without including every minor detail.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: N'ịza ajụjụ aghọtaazaa, gịnị ka o kwesịrị ime ma ọ bụrụ na ọ chọghị ịmata ezigbo ihe a na-ajụ?
options: Ọ ga-alaghachi azụ gụọ akụkụ metụtara edemede ahụ ọzọ tupu ọ zaa ajụjụ ahụ
Ọ ga-eji echiche ya nke onwe ya nke na-enweghị njikọ na edemede ahụ
Ọ ga-esite naanị n'aha ya zaa ajụjụ ahụ
questions.explanation: When uncertain about an answer, it is best to re-read the relevant section of the passage carefully before responding, rather than guessing or leaving the question unanswered.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu uru ọ bara ịmụ otu esi ede akwụkwọ ozi n'asụsụ Igbo?
options: Ọ bụ naanị maka ndị ọrụ gọọmentị
Ọ na-enyere mmadụ aka izikọrịta ozi n'ụzọ ziri ezi na nkwanye ùgwù
questions.explanation: Learning proper letter-writing conventions helps individuals communicate messages clearly and respectfully in formal and informal Igbo written correspondence.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ Agụmagụ Ọnụ n'omenala Igbo?
options: Agụmagụ e si na mba ọzọ tụgharịa
Agụmagụ e si n'ọnụ na-agbasa site n'ọgbọ ruo n'ọgbọ, n'edeghị ede
questions.explanation: Oral literature (Agụmagụ Ọnụ) refers to literary traditions transmitted verbally from generation to generation, rather than through written texts.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ akụkọ ọdịnala nke na-akọwa mmalite ụwa ma ọ bụ ihe omimi banyere chi na mmụọ?
questions.explanation: Myths (nkọmịrịkọ) are traditional narratives that explain the origins of the world, supernatural beings, or sacred phenomena within Igbo oral tradition.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ akụkọ ọdịnala metụtara ndị mmadụ dị ike ma ọ bụ ihe omume mere n'oge gara aga, nke a na-ekwenyekarị na o nwere eziokwu na ya?
questions.explanation: Legends (nkọkịrịkọ) are traditional stories about notable historical figures or events, often believed to contain a kernel of historical truth, unlike purely supernatural myths.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ agụmagụ ọnụ nke a na-agụkarị n'olu dị iche iche mgbe emume na-eme, dịka mmemme ọzọ ma ọ bụ akwamozu?
questions.explanation: Chants (mbem) are rhythmic, often repetitive oral performances recited during ceremonies and important cultural occasions.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ ajụjụ nwere ọkịkọ nke a na-eji egwuri egwu iji nwalee amamihe na uche ọsọ ọsọ?
questions.explanation: Riddles (agwụgwa) are a traditional question-and-answer game designed to test cleverness and quick, creative thinking.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ abụ ọdịnala nke a na-abụkarị n'oge mmemme, ọrụ ubi, ma ọ bụ nwatakịrị?
questions.explanation: Traditional songs (egwu ọdịnala) are performed on various occasions, including festivals, communal work, and children's play, forming an important part of Igbo oral heritage.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu uru agụmagụ ọnụ bara n'ịchekwa ọdịnala na mmụta ọha Igbo?
options: Ọ na-enyere aka ịgbasa ọdịnala, ụkpụrụ, na amamihe site n'ọgbọ ruo n'ọgbọ
Ọ na-elekwasị anya naanị n'akụkọ ọzọ na-abụghị nke Igbo
questions.explanation: Oral literature plays a vital role in preserving and transmitting Igbo customs, values, and wisdom across generations, particularly important before widespread literacy.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu oge a na-akpọkarị agwụgwa (riddles) n'omenala Igbo ochie?
options: Naanị n'oge emume ọlụlụ di na nwunye
Naanị n'oge ememme mbido afọ ọhụrụ
questions.explanation: Traditionally, riddle-telling sessions in Igbo communities commonly took place at night, offering entertainment and mental exercise after the day's work was completed.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe kpatara e ji na-eji nkọmịrịkọ (myths) akọwa ihe omimi banyere okike ụwa n'omenala Igbo?
options: Iji nye nkọwa metụtara mmalite ihe ndị a na-apụghị ịkọwa n'ụzọ sayensị n'oge ochie
Iji zipụ ozi nzuzo nke gọọmentị
questions.explanation: Myths served to explain the origins of natural or supernatural phenomena that could not otherwise be scientifically explained in traditional Igbo society.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe dị iche n'etiti nkọmịrịkọ (myth) na nkọkịrịkọ (legend)?
options: Ha abụọ bụ otu ihe, enweghị ọdịiche ọ bụla
Nkọmịrịkọ na-emetụta ihe omimi na chi, ebe nkọkịrịkọ na-emetụtakarị ndị mmadụ ma ọ bụ ihe omume dị n'akụkọ ihe mere eme
Nkọkịrịkọ bụ naanị maka egwu ntụrụndụ
questions.explanation: Myths typically deal with supernatural or divine explanations, while legends are more closely tied to human figures or events with a historical (though often embellished) basis.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe kacha pụta ìhè n'ụdị egwu ọdịnala a na-abụ n'oge ọrụ ubi n'obodo Igbo?
options: Egwu metụtara mgbanwe ihu igwe naanị
Egwu na-akwalite ume na ịkpali ndị ọrụ ka ha rụsie ọrụ ike
questions.explanation: Farm work songs traditionally serve to energise and motivate labourers, helping to coordinate group efforts and make communal work more enjoyable.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu nkà a na-achọkarị n'aka onye ga-agba mbọ ịkọwapụta agwụgwa (riddle) nke ọma?
options: Ikike iche echiche ngwa ngwa na iji amamihe chọpụta azịza ziri ezi
questions.explanation: Solving riddles effectively requires quick, clever thinking and wisdom to deduce the correct, often unexpected, answer through logical or creative reasoning.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Gịnị bụ isi ọdịiche dị n'etiti agụmagụ ọnụ na agụmagụ edere ede?
options: Agụmagụ ọnụ ka a na-agbasa site n'ọnụ, ebe agụmagụ edere ede ka a na-edekọ n'akwụkwọ
Ọ dịghị ọdịiche dị n'etiti ha
Agụmagụ edere ede bụ naanị maka mmemme ọlụlụ di na nwunye
questions.explanation: The fundamental distinction lies in the mode of transmission and preservation: oral literature is passed down verbally, while written literature is recorded in text form.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ọrụ ndị agadi (elders) na-arụkarị n'ịgbasa agụmagụ ọnụ n'obodo Igbo?
options: Ha na-akọwakarị naanị akụkọ mba ofesi
Ha na-akọrọ ụmụaka na ndị na-eto eto akụkọ ifo, ilu, na amamihe ọdịnala
Ha anaghị etinye aka n'agụmagụ ọnụ ma ọ bụla
questions.explanation: Elders traditionally play a central role as custodians and transmitters of oral literature, sharing folktales, proverbs, and wisdom with younger generations.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe ga-eme ma a ghara ịchekwa agụmagụ ọnụ site n'ọgbọ ruo n'ọgbọ?
options: Ọdịnala ahụ ga-adịgide na-enweghị mgbanwe ọ bụla
A ga-enwe agụmagụ ọnụ karịa mbụ
A ga-efu ọtụtụ ọdịnala na amamihe ndị dị mkpa nke ọdịnala ahụ
Ọ dịghị ihe ga-emeru omenala ahụ
questions.explanation: Without deliberate preservation across generations, much valuable oral tradition and cultural wisdom risks being permanently lost, especially in societies with limited written records.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ụzọ e si eji abụ ọdịnala kpali obi ụtọ n'oge mmemme dị iche iche n'obodo Igbo?
options: Site n'egwu na ukwe na-akpali obi ụtọ na mmekọrịta n'etiti ndị obodo
questions.explanation: Music and songs performed during festivals foster joy and strengthen social bonds among community members, an important social function of oral tradition.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ agụmagụ e dere n'akwụkwọ, dị ka akụkọ, egwuregwu, na abụ e dere ede?
questions.explanation: Written literature (Agụmagụ Edere Ede) refers to literary works recorded in text form, such as novels, plays, and poetry collections, distinct from orally transmitted traditions.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: N'ọmụmụ agụmagụ edere ede, gịnị ka a na-achọkarị n'aka nwa akwụkwọ banyere otu akwụkwọ ọkọwa akụkọ e nyere ya ịgụ?
options: Ka ọ tụgharịa akwụkwọ ahụ gaa n'asụsụ ọzọ
Ka ọ mụtakwaa okwu niile dị n'akwụkwọ ahụ n'isi
Ka ọ ghọta isi ihe, ndị dị n'akụkọ ahụ, na ozi akwụkwọ ahụ na-ebu
Ka ọ bụghịkwa ihe ọ ga-agụ n'ezie
questions.explanation: Studying a prescribed written text requires understanding its central theme, characters, and overall message, rather than merely memorising its content word for word.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ isi ozi ma ọ bụ echiche bụ isi nke onye edemede na-achọ ịkọwa n'ime akwụkwọ ya?
questions.explanation: The theme (isi ihe) of a literary work is its central underlying message or idea that the author seeks to convey through the narrative or poetic content.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: N'agụmagụ edere ede, kedu ihe a na-akpọ ndị mmadụ dị iche iche na-eme ihe n'ime otu akụkọ?
questions.explanation: Characters are the individuals or entities who participate in and drive the events of a literary narrative, essential to analysing prose or drama.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ọrụ JAMB si etinye n'usoro mmụta banyere agụmagụ edere ede Igbo?
options: Ọ na-elebara anya naanị na akụkọ mba ọzọ
Ọ na-ahọpụta akwụkwọ akụkọ, egwuregwu, na abụ ụfọdụ ka ụmụ akwụkwọ mụọ maka ule
Ọ naghị enwe ihe ọ bụla metụtara agụmagụ edere ede
questions.explanation: JAMB specifies a particular set of prescribed prose, drama, and poetry texts that students are expected to study in preparation for the Igbo written literature examination.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu nkà dị mkpa maka nyocha (analysis) nke otu akụkọ ma ọ bụ egwuregwu e dere ede n'asụsụ Igbo?
options: Ikike ịchọpụta isi ihe, ndị ọrụnnọgbu, na ọnọdụ akụkọ ahụ
Ikike ịgụ akwụkwọ ngwa ngwa n'enweghị nghọta
questions.explanation: Effective literary analysis requires the ability to identify a text's theme, characters, and setting, enabling deeper understanding beyond surface-level reading.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ ekele ọdịnala Igbo a na-enyekarị mgbe a hụrụ mmadụ n'ụtụtụ?
questions.explanation: 'Ị bọla chi' is a traditional Igbo morning greeting, reflecting the cultural importance of greetings (ekele) in daily social interaction.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ usoro alụmdi na nwunye n'ọdịnala Igbo, nke gụnyere ịkwụ ụgwọ ọlụlụ (bride price)?
options: Alụmdi na nwunye ọdịnala (traditional marriage institution)
questions.explanation: Traditional Igbo marriage customs (alụmdi na nwunye) typically involve formal processes including negotiations and the payment of bride price (ịkwụ ụgwọ ọlụlụ) between families.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ omenala nke a na-eme mgbe a mụrụ nwa ọhụrụ n'ezinụlọ Igbo?
questions.explanation: Birth rituals (omenala ime ọmụmụ) are traditional practices and ceremonies performed to welcome and mark the arrival of a newborn child in Igbo culture.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ mmemme e ji enye nwa aha ya n'ọdịnala Igbo?
questions.explanation: The naming ceremony (ịgụ aha) formally gives a newborn child their name, typically accompanied by prayers, celebration, and cultural rites specific to Igbo tradition.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ omenala mbibi ugwu nwoke n'ọdịnala Igbo (male circumcision)?
questions.explanation: Ibi ugwu refers to the traditional practice of male circumcision within Igbo culture, often performed as part of broader rites associated with a child's early life.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ usoro nsọpụrụ ọkwa dị iche iche a na-enweta n'obodo Igbo, dịka Ọzọ ma ọ bụ Eze?
questions.explanation: The title-taking system (echichi) confers prestigious social titles, such as Ọzọ, Eze, Igwe, or Iyom, upon individuals who meet the required cultural, social, and sometimes financial criteria.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu otu n'ime ọkwa dị elu a na-enye ndị inyom nsọpụrụ n'ọdịnala Igbo?
questions.explanation: Iyom is a prestigious traditional title conferred upon respected women in many Igbo communities, recognising their social standing and contributions.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ọkwa a na-akpọkarị onye eze ma ọ bụ onyeisi obodo n'ọtụtụ ala Igbo?
questions.explanation: Eze or Igwe are titles commonly used to refer to a traditional ruler or paramount chief in many Igbo communities, symbolising leadership and authority.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe kpatara ọkwa Ọzọ ji dị oke mkpa n'ọtụtụ obodo Igbo?
options: Ọ na-egosi naanị ọgụgụ isi n'akwụkwọ
Ọ bụ naanị maka ndị ọrụ ubi
Ọ na-egosi nsọpụrụ, ọgaranya, na ọnọdụ dị elu nke onye ketara ya n'obodo
Ọ dịghị mkpa ọ bụla n'obodo
questions.explanation: The Ọzọ title holds significant social importance, symbolising respect, wealth, and elevated social status for those who successfully attain it within the community.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ omenala ọlụlụ di na nwunye n'obodo Igbo, ebe ezinụlọ nwoke ga-akwụ ụgwọ maka nwa agbọghọ?
questions.explanation: The payment of bride price (ịkwụ ụgwọ ọlụlụ) is a traditional component of Igbo marriage customs, symbolising the formal union between two families.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu isi mkpa nke ekele n'ọdịnala Igbo?
options: Ọ na-egosipụta naanị ọnọdụ akụ na ụba
Ọ dịghị mkpa ọ bụla n'ọdịnala Igbo
Ọ bụ naanị maka ndị okenye
Ọ na-egosi nkwanye ùgwù na mmekọrịta dị mma n'etiti ndị mmadụ
questions.explanation: Greetings hold significant cultural importance in Igbo society, reflecting respect, politeness, and the maintenance of harmonious social relationships.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ọrụ ndị nne na nna na-arụkarị n'oge ịgụ aha nwa ha?
options: Ha anaghị etinye aka na mmemme ahụ
Ha na-akpọ naanị ndị ọrụ gọọmentị
Ha na-ahọpụta aha nwa ahụ ma na-akpọ ndị ikwu na ndị enyi ka ha soro ṅụrịa ọṅụ
Ha na-emechi ụzọ ọ bụla n'ụlọ ha
questions.explanation: Parents traditionally select the child's name and invite relatives and friends to join in the celebratory naming ceremony, an important communal event.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe kpatara omenala dị iche iche (dịka ịgụ aha na alụmdi na nwunye) ji dị mkpa n'ịchekwa ọdịnala Igbo?
options: Ha enweghị isi ihe ọ bụla
Ha na-enyere aka ịgbasa ma na-echekwa ụkpụrụ na omenala obodo site n'ọgbọ ruo n'ọgbọ
questions.explanation: These cultural institutions play an important role in preserving and transmitting community values and traditions across successive generations.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ nzuko ọha na eze na ndị okenye na-anọchite anya obodo n'ikpe azụmahịa na omume iwu ọdịnala?
options: Nzuko ndị okenye/ndị amala (council of elders/traditional council)
questions.explanation: Traditional councils of elders (ndị okenye/ndị amala) historically play a central role in community decision-making, dispute resolution, and upholding customary law in Igbo society.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Gịnị kpatara e ji akpọ ọtụtụ omenala Igbo 'omenala na ewumewu' n'otu aha?
options: Ha na-egosipụta usoro ndụ obodo na omume ndị metụtara mmekọrịta mmadụ na ibe ya
questions.explanation: 'Omenala na ewumewu' (customs and institutions) collectively describes the traditional social practices and structures that govern communal life and interpersonal relationships in Igbo society.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu mmemme ọdịnala nke a na-elekarị anya na mmekọrịta nwoke na nwaanyị iji hiwe ezinụlọ ọhụrụ n'obodo Igbo?
questions.explanation: Alụmdi na nwunye (marriage) is the traditional institution through which a man and woman formally unite to establish a new family unit within Igbo society.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe kpatara ọtụtụ ndị Igbo ji na-akwanyere ndị nwere ọkwa echichi ùgwù dị ukwuu n'obodo?
options: Ọ bụ naanị maka ọnwụ ha
Ọ na-egosi na ha zuru ezigbo ọrụ na ule iji nweta ọkwa ahụ nke a na-akwanyekarị ùgwù
Ọ bụ naanị maka ndị ọbịa
Ọ dịghị nsọpụrụ ọ bụla dị na ya
questions.explanation: Titled individuals are typically accorded great respect because attaining such titles usually requires meeting significant cultural, social, and sometimes financial requirements.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ nkuzi a na-eme kwa afọ iji zụlite ma kwalite ọdịnala na asụsụ Igbo, nke aha ya sitere n'aha mmiri jiri Ahịajiọkụ?
questions.explanation: The Ahịajiọkụ Lecture is an annual lecture series established to promote and celebrate Igbo language, culture, and scholarship, named after Ahịajiọkụ, the Igbo deity/spirit associated with yams and prosperity.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ nkuzi ọzọ a maara nke ọma banyere mmụta na omenala Igbo, nke a na-akpọkarị 'Odenigbo Lecture'?
questions.explanation: The Odenigbo Lecture is another significant annual lecture platform dedicated to discussing and advancing Igbo language, culture, and contemporary issues affecting Igbo people.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ọrụ Ọhanaeze Ndigbo na-arụ n'etiti ndị Igbo?
options: Ọ bụ ụlọ ọrụ azụmahịa mba ofesi
Ọ bụ nzukọ na-anọchite anya ma kwado ọdịmma, mmepe, na ọdịnala ndị Igbo
questions.explanation: Ọhanaeze Ndigbo functions as a prominent socio-cultural organisation representing and advocating for the welfare, development, and cultural interests of the Igbo people.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ nzukọ ndị ọkà mmụta na-elekwasị anya n'ọmụmụ na mmepe asụsụ na omenala Igbo, nke a na-akpọ Igbo Studies Association (ISA)?
questions.explanation: The Igbo Studies Association (ISA) is an academic organisation dedicated to the scholarly study, research, and promotion of Igbo language, culture, and related fields.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe kpatara ọ dị mkpa ịmụ maka ihe ngwa nke ugbu a (current affairs) metụtara ndị Igbo dịka akụkụ nke ule Igbo?
options: Iji lekwasị anya naanị n'akụkọ mba ọzọ
Iji zere ihe gbasara ọdịnala ochie kpamkpam
Iji hụ na ụmụ akwụkwọ ghọtara mmepe na ọnọdụ ugbu a metụtara asụsụ na omenala Igbo
questions.explanation: Understanding current affairs ensures that students are aware of ongoing developments, initiatives, and contemporary issues affecting the Igbo language and culture, complementing historical knowledge.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ọrụ dị mkpa nzukọ ndị dịka Ọhanaeze Ndigbo na-arụ n'ịkwado mmepe asụsụ Igbo n'oge a?
options: Ha na-elekwasị anya naanị n'ihe metụtara mba ofesi
Ha anaghị enwe ihe ọ bụla metụtara asụsụ Igbo
Ha na-akwado mmemme na atụmatụ nke ga-eme ka asụsụ na omenala Igbo dịgide ma too
questions.explanation: Organisations like Ọhanaeze Ndigbo actively support programmes and initiatives aimed at sustaining and promoting the growth of Igbo language and culture.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ọdịiche dị n'etiti Ahịajiọkụ Lecture na Odenigbo Lecture?
options: Ha bụ otu ihe kpamkpam na-enweghị ọdịiche ọ bụla
Naanị Ahịajiọkụ bụ nkuzi metụtara Igbo
Naanị Odenigbo bụ nkuzi metụtara Igbo
Ha abụọ bụ nkuzi iri na afọ dị iche iche nke chọrọ ịkwalite asụsụ na omenala Igbo, mana ha nwere aha na ndabere iche
questions.explanation: While both are prominent annual lecture platforms promoting Igbo language and culture, they are distinct series with different names and specific historical or institutional origins.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Gịnị mere ọ ga-eji dị mkpa maka ụmụ akwụkwọ ịmụta banyere nzukọ dịka Igbo Studies Association?
options: Ka ha ghara ịchọpụta ihe ọ bụla banyere Igbo
Ka ha mata naanị akụkọ mba ọzọ
Ka ha zere ọmụmụ asụsụ Igbo kpamkpam
Ka ha mata otu a si eme nnyocha sayensị metụtara asụsụ na omenala Igbo n'ọgbọ a
questions.explanation: Learning about organisations like ISA helps students appreciate the ongoing scholarly and academic research being conducted on the Igbo language and culture in contemporary times.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ọrụ ndị nkuzi na ndị ọkà mmụta na-arụ na mmemme dịka Ahịajiọkụ Lecture?
options: Ha na-enye nkuzi na nyocha metụtara ihe ndị dị mkpa gbasara asụsụ, omenala, na mmepe Igbo
Ha anaghị arụ ọrụ ọ bụla na mmemme ahụ
Ha na-arụ ọrụ metụtara ndị agha naanị
questions.explanation: Scholars and lecturers at events like the Ahịajiọkụ Lecture deliver presentations and research addressing important themes related to Igbo language, culture, and development.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu isi ihe mmụta na-emeziri ma ọ bụrụ na a gụnyere akụkụ 'Ihe Ngwa nke Ugbu a' n'usoro ule Igbo?
options: Ọ na-elekwasị anya naanị n'akụkọ ihe mere eme nke narị afọ gara aga
Ọ dịghị ihe ọ bụla ọ na-akpachapụ anya na ya
Ọ na-akpọchi mmụta banyere ọdịnala ochie kpamkpam
Ọ na-eme ka ụmụ akwụkwọ mata mmepe na ọnọdụ dị ugbu a metụtara asụsụ na omenala Igbo, na-abụghị naanị akụkọ ochie
questions.explanation: Including current affairs ensures that Igbo studies remain relevant and up-to-date, complementing historical and traditional content with awareness of contemporary developments.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe ndị nzukọ dịka Ọhanaeze Ndigbo na-agbalịkarị ime n'ihe gbasara mmekọrịta obodo Igbo na mba Naịjirịa n'ozuzu ya?
options: Ha na-elekwasị anya naanị n'egwuregwu bọọlụ
Ha na-arụ ọrụ metụtara naanị mba ofesi
Ha anaghị enwe ihe ọ bụla metụtara mmekọrịta mba
Ha na-anọchi anya ma kwuchite ọnụ maka mmasị na ọdịmma ndị Igbo n'ala Naịjirịa
questions.explanation: Organisations such as Ọhanaeze Ndigbo actively represent and advocate for the interests and welfare of the Igbo people within the broader Nigerian nation.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ọdịnala a na-akpọ mmemme iri ji ọhụrụ n'ọtụtụ obodo Igbo, nke na-egosi ekele maka owuwe ihe ubi?
questions.explanation: Iwa Ji (the New Yam Festival) is a significant traditional harvest celebration among Igbo communities, expressing gratitude for a successful yam harvest and marking the start of a new farming season.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu isi ihe a na-eme n'ememme Iwa Ji n'ọtụtụ obodo Igbo?
options: Ikpu ji ọhụrụ na ekele nye chi maka owuwe ihe ubi
questions.explanation: The New Yam Festival centrally involves the ceremonial cooking and eating of the new yam harvest, along with prayers and thanksgiving to the deities/spirits for a bountiful farming season.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu uru mmemme dịka Iwa Ji na-abara ọha obodo Igbo n'ozuzu ya?
options: Ọ na-egbochi mmekọrịta n'etiti ndị obodo
Ọ na-akwalite ịdị n'otu obodo na ekele maka owuwe ihe ubi zuru oke
Ọ dịghị uru ọ bụla dị na ya
Ọ bụ naanị maka ndị ọrụ ubi
questions.explanation: Festivals like Iwa Ji strengthen communal unity and express collective gratitude for a successful harvest, reinforcing social bonds within the community.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ọrụ ndị mmụta na ndị nkuzi (scholars) na-arụ n'ịkwalite mmụta banyere asụsụ na omenala Igbo n'ụlọ akwụkwọ dị elu?
options: Ha anaghị etinye aka na mmụta Igbo ọ bụla
Ha na-eme nnyocha ma kwụsara mmụba nghọta banyere ihe ndị dị mkpa gbasara Igbo n'ọgbọ a
Ha na-elekwasị anya naanị n'asụsụ ọzọ
Ha na-egbochi mmụta Igbo n'ụlọ akwụkwọ
questions.explanation: Scholars and educators contribute to Igbo studies through ongoing research and by expanding contemporary understanding of important issues relevant to the language and culture.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: N'ime mkpụrụokwu anọ ndị a, kedu nke mebiri iwu ndakọrịta ụdaume (vowel harmony) n'ihi ijikọta ụdaume si na ìgwè abụọ dị iche iche n'otu okwu?
questions.explanation: 'Ikike' na-ejikọta ụdaume 'i' na 'a' bụ ndị si n'ìgwè ụdaume abụọ dị iche iche n'otu okwu, na-emebi iwu ndakọrịta ụdaume.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe kpatara a na-ewere 'm' na 'n' dịka mkpụrụedemede zuru oke n'okwu dịka 'nna' na 'nne', ọ bụghị dịka mgbochiume nkịtị?
options: N'ihi na ha na-arụ ọrụ dịka ụdaume, na-eburu olu na enweghị ụdaume ọzọ na-esote ha ozugbo
N'ihi na ha bụ akara olu
N'ihi na ha bụ mkpọaha na-anọchi mgbochiume ọzọ
N'ihi na ha na-apụtakarị naanị n'ọgwụgwụ okwu
questions.explanation: Nsi-imi 'm' na 'n' na-abụ mkpụrụedemede syllabic mgbe ha na-eburu olu n'onwe ha dịka ụdaume, ọ bụghị nanị mgbochi ikuku efu.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ọdịiche kachasị pụta ìhè dị n'etiti akara olu elu (high tone) na akara ọdịda (downstep) n'ederede Igbo?
options: Akara ọdịda na-egosi olu elu nke dịtu ala karịa olu elu chiri anya nke bu ụzọ ya
Ha abụọ na-egosi otu ọkwa olu, enweghị ọdịiche
Akara olu elu bụ naanị maka ajụjụ
Akara ọdịda na-egosi na okwu ahụ bụ mkpọaha
questions.explanation: Downstep na-egosi olu elu nke dịtu ala karịa olu elu nke bu ụzọ ya n'ahịrịokwu, ọ bụghị olu elu zuru oke ma ọ bụ olu ala.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: N'ọmụmụ ụdaasụsụ Igbo, gịnị bụ isi ihe na-eme ka mkpụrụokwu abụọ e dere otu ụzọ n'ederede efu (na-enweghị akara olu) dịrị iche na nghọta?
options: Ọdịiche dị n'olu (tone) nke a na-anụ mgbe a na-akpọ ha n'ọnụ
Ọ dịghị ọdịiche ọ bụla n'etiti ha
questions.explanation: Ọtụtụ okwu Igbo yiri onwe ha n'ederede efu mana ha dị iche site n'olu, nke na-egosi na tone bụ akụkụ dị oke mkpa n'ịkọwapụta echiche.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ụzọ kachasị ziri ezi e si akọwa mmegharị ụda (assimilation) n'asụsụ Igbo?
options: Ọ bụ mgbe otu ụda na-agbanwe ka o yie ụda dị n'akụkụ ya iji mee ka ịkpọpụta ya dị mfe
Ọ bụ mgbe akara olu na-agbanwe n'ime akwụkwọ ozi
Ọ bụ mgbe a na-ewepụ ụdaume niile n'okwu
Ọ bụ mgbe a na-agbakwunye mgbochiume ọhụrụ n'okwu ọ bụla
questions.explanation: Assimilation bụ usoro nke otu ụda na-agbanwe iji yie ụda dị n'akụkụ ya, na-eme ka okwu ahụ dị mfe ịkpọpụta.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: N'usoro mkpụrụedemede Onwu, gịnị mere e ji edobe mgbochiume abụọ ọnụ dịka 'gb', 'kp', na 'gh' dịka otu mkpụrụedemede (digraph), ọ bụghị mkpụrụedemede abụọ dị iche iche?
options: N'ihi na ọ na-eme ka okwu dị mkpụmkpụ
N'ihi na ha na-egosi ụda dị iche na nke mkpụrụedemede ọ bụla n'ime ha ga-egosi naanị ya
N'ihi na ndị Bekee kwuru ka a mee otú ahụ
N'ihi na ha bụ ụdaume abụọ jikọrọ ọnụ
questions.explanation: Digraph dịka 'gb' na 'kp' na-anọchite otu ụda pụrụ iche, kama ọ bụ mkpụrụedemede abụọ na-akpọ n'otu oge.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Ọ bụrụ na e nyochaa mkpụrụokwu 'ọkụkọ', kedu ọnụọgụgụ mkpụrụedemede (syllable) dị n'ime ya?
questions.explanation: 'Ọkụkọ' nwere mkpụrụedemede atọ: ọ-kụ-kọ, nke ọ bụla na-adabere n'otu ụdaume.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe kpatara ọ dị mkpa ịmata ndakọrịta ụdaume mgbe a na-agbakwunye mgbakwunye (affix) na mgbanwụ okwu Igbo?
options: N'ihi na mgbakwunye niile ga-abụ naanị 'a'
N'ihi na mgbakwunye ahụ aghaghị ịdaba n'otu ìgwè ụdaume dị n'okwu isi ka okwu ahụ ghara ịda ụda ọjọọ
N'ihi na ndakọrịta ụdaume adịghị emetụta mgbakwunye ọ bụla
N'ihi na ọ bụ iwu gọọmentị
questions.explanation: Mgbe a na-agbakwunye affix, ụdaume ya na-emekarị ka o kwekọọ na ìgwè ụdaume nke okwu isi ahụ dịka iwu ndakọrịta ụdaume si dị.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: N'ụdaasụsụ Igbo, kedu ụdị mkpụrụedemede a na-akpọ nke na-akwụsị n'ụdaume dịka na 'to' ma ọ bụ 'ga'?
questions.explanation: 'To' na 'ga' bụ CV, na-akwụsị n'ụdaume, mere ha bụ open syllable, ọ bụghị closed syllable nke na-akwụsị na mgbochiume.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Ọ bụrụ na onye na-amụ Igbo dee 'akwụkwọ' kama 'akwukwo' (na-enweghị akara ụdaume ndị ahụ, dịka ụ na ọ), gịnị ka nsogbu ahụ pụtara?
options: O nwere ike ịgbanwe nghọta ma ọ bụ ịbụ okwu ọzọ dị iche na echiche onye edere ya bu n'obi
Ọ dịghị nsogbu ọ bụla, ha bụ otu ihe
Ọ na-egosi na Igbo enweghị ụdaume ndị dị iche iche
Ọ bụ naanị mmehie n'akwụkwọ ozi
questions.explanation: Ihapụ akara pụrụ iche dị n'ụdaume Igbo (dịka ị, ọ, ụ) nwere ike ime ka okwu ghọọ okwu ọzọ kpamkpam ma ọ bụ daa ada n'ọzụzụ ụdaume ziri ezi.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ọdịiche dị n'etiti akara nsupe dịka Ọnwụ si hazie ya na akara mbụ ndị e ji ede Igbo tupu 1961?
options: Usoro Ọnwụ hiwere otu usoro mkpụrụedemede zuru oke maka mpaghara Igbo niile, ebe usoro mbụ ndị ọzọ (dịka Lepsius) gbasoro ụzọ dị iche iche
Usoro Ọnwụ bụ nke Bekee dere kpamkpam
Usoro mbụ ka a na-eji ugbu a
questions.explanation: Usoro Ọnwụ, nke e mepụtara na 1961, jikọtara amamịhe sitere n'usoro mbụ (dịka Lepsius) iji hiwe otu usoro nsupe zuru oke maka mpaghara Igbo niile.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: N'ịtụle akara olu Igbo, gịnị ka a na-akpọ okwu abụọ e dere otu n'ederede efu mana dị iche n'olu na nghọta, dịka 'akwa' (ákwà - uwe) na 'akwa' (àkwà - ihe nkịrịka)?
questions.explanation: Okwu ndị dị otu n'ederede efu mana e ji naanị olu (tone) kpọwaa nghọta ha bụ ihe a na-akpọ tonal minimal pairs, na-egosi na olu bụ akụkụ dị oke mkpa n'asụsụ Igbo.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ ụdaume ndị dị na ìgwè 'i, u, e, o' megide ndị dị na ìgwè 'ị, ụ, a, ọ' n'usoro ndakọrịta ụdaume Igbo?
options: Ha bụ ìgwè ụdaume abụọ dị iche (harmonic sets) nke na-achịkọba usoro ndakọrịta ụdaume
questions.explanation: Ụdaume Igbo na-adabere n'otu n'ime ìgwè abụọ (harmonic sets), nke na-eduzi usoro ndakọrịta ụdaume n'ime otu okwu.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe kpatara ọ na-esiri ndị na-amụ Igbo dịka asụsụ nke abụọ ike ịmata ọdịiche dị n'etiti 'ị' na 'i' ma ọ bụ 'ọ' na 'o'?
options: N'ihi na ha abụọ bụ otu ụda kpamkpam
N'ihi na ha adịghị emetụta nghọta okwu ọ bụla
N'ihi na ha bụ ụdaume dị iche site n'ọnọdụ ire na ọnụ mgbe a na-akpọpụta ha, ọ bụ ezie na ha yiri ibe ha n'ederede
questions.explanation: Ụdaume dịka 'ị' na 'i' ma ọ bụ 'ọ' na 'o' bụ ụdaume dị iche na ha site n'ọnọdụ ire na mkpọpụta, ọ bụ ezie na ha nwere myirịta olu.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ mkpụrụedemede nke ụdaume ya na-adịghị ekwe nghọta n'onwe ya ma ọ bụrụ na e wepụ ya n'ọnọdụ ya n'ahịrịokwu, dịka na nkeji mkpụrụokwu 'kwa' n'okwu 'akwaeze'?
questions.explanation: Otu mkpụrụedemede ma ọ bụ morpheme na-adabere bụ nke na-enweghị nghọta zuru oke ma ọ bụrụ na e wepụtara ya n'onwe ya, kama ọ dabere n'akụkụ okwu ndị ọzọ.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: N'ikpe ụda Igbo, gịnị mere mgbochiume dịka 'gb', 'kp' ji pụta iche n'ọtụtụ asụsụ ndị ọzọ dị n'ụwa?
options: Ha bụ ụda a na-akpọpụta site na mmechi abụọ (labial-velar) na otu oge, nke na-adịghị ahụkarị n'asụsụ Bekee
Ha adịghị arụ ọrụ ọ bụla n'asụsụ Igbo
questions.explanation: Ụda labial-velar dịka 'gb' na 'kp' bụ ndị e ji ọnụ na imi mechie n'otu oge, ụdị ụda a na-adịghị ahụkarị n'asụsụ ndị dịka Bekee.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe kpatara ndị ọkà mmụta ụdaasụsụ ji ekewapụ ọmụmụ 'ụda okwu' (phonetics) na 'usoro ụda okwu' (phonology) dịka isi ihe abụọ dị iche na ọmụmụ asụsụ?
options: Ha bụ otu ihe kpamkpam, enweghị ọdịiche
Phonetics na-elebara anya n'otu e si akpọpụta ụda n'anụ ahụ, ebe phonology na-elebara anya n'otu ụda ndị ahụ si arụkọ ọrụ n'usoro n'asụsụ ahụ
questions.explanation: Phonetics na-elebara anya n'ụzụ anụ ahụ e si akpọpụta ụda, ebe phonology na-elebara anya n'otu ụda ndị ahụ si arụkọ ọrụ dịka usoro n'ime otu asụsụ.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Ọ bụrụ na a na-akpọ ' egbe' n'olu dị iche iche ka ọ pụta 'anụ ufe' otu mgbe, 'ngwa agha' mgbe ọzọ, gịnị ka nke a na-egosipụta banyere olu n'asụsụ Igbo?
options: Na olu bụ akụkụ dị oke mkpa nke na-akpọwa (disambiguate) okwu ndị yiri onwe ha n'ederede efu
Na olu adịghị emetụta nghọta okwu Igbo ma ọ bụla
Na 'egbe' na-egosi naanị otu ihe n'agbanyeghị olu
Na olu bụ ihe metụtara naanị agụmagụ ọnụ
questions.explanation: Tone bụ ihe kachasị mkpa na-akpọwa okwu Igbo ndị dị otu n'ederede efu mana pụtara ihe dị iche, dịka 'égbè' (anụ ufe) na 'ègbè' (ngwa agha).

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ akụkụ ụtọasụsụ na-elebara anya n'otu e si emepụta ma haziwa okwu (word formation) n'asụsụ Igbo, dịka mgbakwunye affix?
questions.explanation: Morphology bụ akụkụ ụtọasụsụ na-elebara anya n'ime akụkụ mkpụrụokwu dị iche iche (morphemes) na otu e si ejikọta ha imepụta okwu.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Ọ bụrụ na a na-eji ndakọrịta ụdaume tụọ mgbakwunye ihu dabara na mkpụrụokwu 'gba' (nke dị n'ìgwè 'a, ọ, ụ, ị'), kedu mgbakwunye ihu ga-adabakwuru ya n'otu ìgwè?
questions.explanation: N'ihi na 'gba' dabara n'ìgwè ụdaume 'a, ọ, ụ, ị', mgbakwunye ihu ga-eji ụdaume site n'otu ìgwè ahụ, ya bụ 'a-', dịka na 'agba'.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: N'ahịrịokwu 'Nwaanyị mara mma ahụ na-ere ahịa nke ọma', kedu okwu bụ nkọwa (adjective) n'ahịrịokwu ahụ?
questions.explanation: 'Mara mma' na-akọwapụta àdị nke 'nwaanyị' (mkpọaha), na-eme ka ọ bụrụ nkọwa n'ahịrịokwu ahụ.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: N'ahịrịokwu 'Ọ na-agba ọsọ ọsọ banye n'ime ụlọ', kedu ọrụ 'ọsọ ọsọ' na-arụ n'ahịrịokwu ahụ?
options: Ọ bụ nkwuwa na-akọwa otu ihe si eme (adverb of manner)
questions.explanation: 'Ọsọ ọsọ' na-akọwa otú ngwaa 'agba' si eme, ya bụ na ọ na-arụ ọrụ dịka nkwuwa (adverb) nke ụzọ.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe kpatara e ji akpọ okwu 'na' n'ahịrịokwu 'O bịara na ụtụtụ' ihe dị iche na 'na' dị n'ahịrịokwu 'Ọ na-abịa'?
options: Nke mbụ bụ mbuuzo, ebe nke abụọ bụ akụkụ nke usoro ngwaa (aspect marker) na-egosi ọrụ na-aga n'ihu
Ha bụ otu ọrụ n'ụdị abụọ ahụ
questions.explanation: 'Na' nwere ike ịrụ ọrụ dị iche iche n'Igbo: dịka mbuuzo na-egosi oge/ọnọdụ, ma ọ bụ dịka akara aspect na-egosi ọrụ na-aga n'ihu (continuous), nke bụ ihe na-esiri ndị mụrụ Igbo ọhụrụ ike ịmata.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: N'ime ndepụta okwu ndị a, kedu nnọchiaha (pronoun) na-egosi ọtụtụ ndị onye na-agwa okwu na-etinye onwe ya, ma na-agụnyekwa onye a na-agwa okwu (inclusive 'we')?
questions.explanation: 'Anyị' bụ nnọchiaha ọtụtụ nke mbụ, nke na-egosi onye na-ekwu okwu na ndị ọzọ so ya, dị ka ike ọ dị ịgụnye ma ọ bụ hapụ onye a na-agwa okwu dabere n'ọnọdụ.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: N'ahịrịokwu 'Ọ dara n'elu tebụl ahụ', kedu okwu bụ mbuuzo (preposition)?
questions.explanation: 'N'elu' na-egosipụta ọnọdụ ebe ihe dabara metụtara ihe ọzọ (tebụl), nke bụ ọrụ mbuuzo.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe dị iche n'etiti ahịrịokwu jikọrọ ọnụ (compound sentence) na ahịrịokwu dabere (complex sentence) n'ụtọasụsụ Igbo?
options: Ahịrịokwu jikọrọ ọnụ nwere ahịrịokwu nnwere onwe abụọ jikọrọ site na njikọ okwu ha nhata, ebe ahịrịokwu dabere nwere ahịrịokwu nnwere onwe na ahịrịokwu dabere (subordinate clause) na-adabere na ya
Naanị ahịrịokwu dabere ka a na-eji edee akwụkwọ ozi
Ahịrịokwu jikọrọ ọnụ enweghị njikọ okwu ọ bụla
questions.explanation: Ahịrịokwu jikọrọ ọnụ jikọtara ahịrịokwu nnwere onwe abụọ dị nha, ebe ahịrịokwu dabere nwere otu ahịrịokwu dabere na-arụ ọrụ dabere n'ahịrịokwu isi.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: N'ahịrịokwu ajụjụ 'Ị gaghị azụ ahịa taa?', kedu ụdị ahịrịokwu ka nke a bụ dabere n'echiche ọ na-ebute?
options: Ahịrịokwu ajụjụ na-eche azịza 'ee' ma ọ bụ 'mba' (yes/no question)
questions.explanation: Ajụjụ dị otú a chọrọ naanị azịza 'ee' ma ọ bụ 'mba', na-eme ka ọ bụrụ ajụjụ ụdị yes/no.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Ọ bụrụ na e kwuo na ngwaa Igbo nwere 'mgbakwunye ọnọdụ oge gara aga' (past tense marker), kedu n'ime okwu ndị a nwere ya?
questions.explanation: 'O riri' egosi na omume ahụ mezuru n'oge gara aga, site n'iji suffix '-rị/-ri' na-egosi past tense, dị iche na 'na-eri' (present continuous) ma ọ bụ 'ga-eri' (future).

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ọdịiche dị n'etiti mgbakwunye ihu (prefix) na mgbakwunye azụ (suffix) n'ụtọasụsụ Igbo?
options: Ha bụ otu ihe, naanị aha ha dị iche
Mgbakwunye ihu na-adịkarị naanị na ngwaa, ebe mgbakwunye azụ adịghị adakwunye na ngwaa
Mgbakwunye ihu na-adakwunye n'isi okwu tupu ya, ebe mgbakwunye azụ na-adakwunye n'azụ okwu
Ọ dịghị mgbakwunye ihu dị n'Igbo
questions.explanation: Prefix na-adakwunye n'ihu (mbụ) okwu isi, ebe suffix na-adakwunye n'azụ okwu isi, ha abụọ na-agbanwe echiche ma ọ bụ ọrụ ụtọasụsụ nke okwu ahụ.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: N'ịmụba mkpụrụokwu Igbo, kedu ihe dị iche n'etiti 'mbite' (loan word) na 'mbiọgwa' (loan blend)?
options: Mbiọgwa bụ naanị okwu ochie Igbo
Mbite bụ mkpụrụokwu e siri n'asụsụ ọzọ were kpamkpam n'agbanwụghị agbanwụ, ebe mbiọgwa bụ mgbakọ nke akụkụ okwu si n'asụsụ ọzọ na akụkụ si n'Igbo
Mbite adịghị apụta n'asụsụ Igbo ọ bụla
questions.explanation: Mbite bụ nnabata okwu n'uju sitere n'asụsụ ọzọ (dịka 'sinima' si na 'cinema'), ebe mbiọgwa bụ okwu ọhụrụ e ji akụkụ si n'asụsụ ọzọ na akụkụ Igbo kpakọta ọnụ.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ụdị edemede a ga-eji dee ma a chọrọ ka e dee banyere 'Otu ụbọchị m na-echezọghị n'ndụ m'?
questions.explanation: Ide banyere otu ihe omume mere n'ụbọchị a na-echefughị chọrọ akụkọ n'usoro nke ọdịda ya, nke bụ njirimara edemede akụkọ.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: N'ide akwụkwọ ozi ọrụ (official letter) n'asụsụ Igbo, gịnị dị iche na akwụkwọ ozi enyi na enyi (informal letter) maka ụdị asụsụ e ji ya?
options: Ha abụọ na-eji otu ụdị asụsụ
Akwụkwọ ozi ọrụ na-eji asụsụ ekwenti nkịtị karịa
Ọ dịghị ọdịiche dị n'etiti ha abụọ
Akwụkwọ ozi ọrụ na-eji asụsụ nkwanye ùgwù na nke ziri ezi, ebe nke enyi na enyi nwere ike iji asụsụ efu na nnabata
questions.explanation: Akwụkwọ ozi ọrụ na-achọ asụsụ nkwanye ùgwù na nhazi doro anya, ebe akwụkwọ ozi enyi na enyi nwere ohere iji olu efu karịa.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: N'ịza ajụjụ aghọtaazaa metụtara edemede, gịnị kpatara ọ na-adịkarị mma ka a jiri okwu nke onye edere ihe ahụ ji dee ya kama ikpughe echiche nke onwe onye?
options: N'ihi na ọ dị mkpụmkpụ karịa
N'ihi na azịza kwesịrị isite n'ihe akwụkwọ ahụ kwuru, ọ bụghị n'echiche onye na-aza ya
N'ihi na ọ na-egosi ọgụgụ isi karịa
N'ihi na o nweghị ihe ọzọ a ga-eme
questions.explanation: Aghọtaazaa chọrọ ka azịza sitere n'ozi dị n'ime edemede ahụ n'onwe ya, ọ bụghị echiche onye na-aza ya na-abụghị nke edemede ahụ kwuru.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ okwu na-egosi ọtụtụ mkpọaha n'ọnọdụ 'nnwere onwe' (independent), dị ka 'ọ', kama ijikọ ya na aha nke a kpọrọ aha na mbụ?
questions.explanation: 'Ọ' bụ nnọchiaha nkịtị na-anọchi aha mmadụ ma ọ bụ ihe a kpọtụrụ aha na mbụ, dị iche na nnọchiaha nweta dịka 'nke ya'.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: N'ahịrịokwu 'Nwoke ahụ bụ onye dibịa mgbe ọ nọ n'obodo ochie, ma ọ bụghịzi ugbu a', gịnị bụ ọrụ ụtọasụsụ nke 'mgbe' n'ahịrịokwu ahụ?
options: Ọ na-arụ ọrụ dịka njikọ okwu nke oge (temporal conjunction) na-ejikọ akụkụ ahịrịokwu abụọ
questions.explanation: 'Mgbe' na-ejikọ akụkụ ahịrịokwu abụọ na-egosipụta oge, na-arụ ọrụ dịka njikọ okwu.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Ọ bụrụ na a na-akọwa okwu ọhụrụ dịka 'ígwè ozi' (telephone/radio) e mepụtara iji kwuo maka teknụzụ ọhụrụ, kedu usoro ịmụbawanye mkpụrụokwu ka nke a kacha gosipụta?
options: Mbite (loan word) sitere na Bekee kpamkpam
Ịmepụta okwu ọhụrụ (word coinage) site n'ijikọta okwu Igbo ndị dị adị iji kwupụta echiche ọhụrụ
questions.explanation: 'Ígwè ozi' bụ okwu e ji akụkụ Igbo ndị dị adị ('ígwè' na 'ozi') kpokọta iji gosipụta echiche ọhụrụ, nke bụ ọrụ ịmepụta okwu ọhụrụ karịa ọ bụ nanị mbite.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: N'ụtọasụsụ Igbo, kedu ihe a na-akpọ ahịrịokwu na-enweghị onye/ihe na-eme ihe doro anya n'ihu ma ọ bụ nke a na-enye iwu ozugbo, dịka 'Mechie ụzọ ahụ!'?
options: Ahịrịokwu iwu (imperative), ebe onye a na-agwa okwu bụ onye/ihe na-eme ihe a na-ahụghị anya n'ihu
questions.explanation: N'ahịrịokwu iwu, onye a na-agwa okwu ('gị') na-adịkarị na-apụtaghị ìhè n'ederede mana ọ na-adị na-eme (implied subject).

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe kacha pụta ìhè ga-eme ka nkọwa (adjective) na nkwuwa (adverb) Igbo dị iche mgbe ha abụọ na-akọwa ihe?
options: Nkọwa na-akọwa mkpọaha, ebe nkwuwa na-akọwa ngwaa, nkọwa ọzọ, ma ọ bụ nkwuwa ọzọ
questions.explanation: Nkọwa na-arụ ọrụ n'akụkụ mkpọaha, ebe nkwuwa na-arụ ọrụ n'akụkụ ngwaa, nkọwa ọzọ, ma ọ bụ nkwuwa ọzọ, otu a na-eme ka ha dị iche n'ọrụ ụtọasụsụ.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: N'ihe gbasara mbite (loan words) n'asụsụ Igbo, gịnị mere okwu dịka 'sịkirin' (screen) si aghọ mkpụrụokwu Igbo kama ọ ga-abụ 'screen' kpọmkwem?
options: N'ihi na ọ bụ mmehie nsupe
N'ihi na Bekee anaghị enwe mkpụrụokwu ahụ
N'ihi na ọ bụ okwu ochie Igbo
N'ihi na a na-emegharị ụda mbite iji dabara na usoro ụdaasụsụ na nsupe Igbo
questions.explanation: Mgbe a na-anabata mbite n'Igbo, a na-emegharịkarị ụda ha ka ha dabara na usoro ụdaasụsụ na nsupe Igbo, dịka 'sịkirin' maka 'screen'.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ nkewa nke akwụkwọ akụkọ ma ọ bụ edemede ederede na akụkụ dị iche iche dịka mmalite, etiti, na ngwụcha?
questions.explanation: Plot structure na-egosipụta usoro nkewa nke akụkọ site na mmalite, etiti (nke gụnyere esemokwu na mkpọtụ), ruo na ngwụcha ya.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ọdịiche kachasị pụta ìhè dị n'etiti 'ifo' (folktale) na 'nkọmịrịkọ' (myth) n'agụmagụ ọnụ Igbo?
options: Nkọmịrịkọ bụkarị akụkọ ntụrụndụ maka anụmanụ, ebe ifo bụ nke chi
Ifo bụkarị akụkọ ntụrụndụ nwere ụmụ anụmanụ na-ekwu okwu iji kụziri omume, ebe nkọmịrịkọ na-akọwapụta ihe omimi banyere okike na chi
Ifo adịghị enwe ozi ọ bụla
questions.explanation: Ifo bụkarị akụkọ ntụrụndụ (nwere ụmụ anụmanụ dịka mgbagwoju) e ji akụzi omume ọma, ebe nkọmịrịkọ na-elebara anya n'ihe omimi gbasara okike ụwa na chi.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ akụkọ ntụrụndụ nke a na-akọkarị maka mgba aka dị n'etiti mbeku na anụmanụ ndị ọzọ, ebe mbeku na-eji aghụghọ merie ndị dị ike karịa ya?
questions.explanation: Akụkọ ntụrụndụ metụtara mbeku (tortoise) na aghụghọ ya bụ ụdị ifo (folktale) a maara nke ọma n'agụmagụ ọnụ Igbo, e ji akụzi omume banyere aghụghọ na ụzọ ọ na-eweta.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ akụkọ nkenke, na-abụkarị nke akụkọ mmadụ metụtara, e ji akọwa ihe ma ọ bụ omume site n'ihe atụ (anecdote) n'agụmagụ ọnụ Igbo?
questions.explanation: Ụkabụilu bụ akụkọ nkenke, dịka ihe atụ mere eme, e ji akọwa ma ọ bụ kwado echiche n'ikpe azụmahịa ma ọ bụ nkuzi.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Ọ bụrụ na e nyochaa ilu Igbo 'Nwata bulie nna ya elu, ọ na-anya afọ ya', kedu ihe ọ na-akọwa n'usoro nkwuwaokwu (figurative meaning)?
options: Ka ụmụaka bulie nna ha n'ụzọ anụ ahụ
Na ụmụaka kwesịrị ịmụ ịbu ibu
Na mgbe onye nwere nsogbu ọ bụla na-akwado onye ọzọ, ọ ga-adaba n'onwe ya
Na nna kwesịrị ibulite ụmụ ya
questions.explanation: Ilu a na-egosipụta na mgbe onye na-elelị onwe ya anya jisie ike kwado onye ọzọ nke bụ nsogbu, o nwere ike ịbịakwute ya n'onwe ya.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe kacha pụta ìhè dị iche n'etiti ilu (proverb) na mbụrụ (metaphor) dịka ụdị okwu okike (figures of speech) n'asụsụ Igbo?
options: Ilu bụ ikwu na ihe bụ ihe ọzọ kpọmkwem na-adịghị eji njikọ ọ bụla, ebe mbụrụ bụ akụkọ ọdịnala nkenke
Ilu bụ okwu amamihe na-adabere n'ọdịnala, na-ejikarị ihe abụọ tụnyere ibe ya; mbụrụ bụ ikwu na ihe bụ ihe ọzọ n'ụzọ kpọmkwem na-eji 'dịka' ma ọ bụ 'ka'
Mbụrụ bụ naanị ihe metụtara egwu
questions.explanation: Ilu bụ okwu amamihe si n'ọdịnala nke na-eji ọkwa tụnyere ndụ, ebe mbụrụ (metaphor) bụ ikwu na otu ihe bụ ihe ọzọ n'ụzọ kpọmkwem iji nye ya nkọwa ọzọ.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: N'ahịrịokwu 'Obi ya bụ nnukwu ọzụzụ ọkụ', kedu ụdị okwu okike (figure of speech) e ji ya?
questions.explanation: Ịkpọ obi mmadụ 'nnukwu ọzụzụ ọkụ' n'ụzọ kpọmkwem, na-adịghị eji 'dịka' ma ọ bụ 'ka', bụ mbụrụ (metaphor), ọ bụghị myiri.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe dị iche n'etiti myiri (simile) na mbụrụ (metaphor)?
options: Ha bụ otu ihe, naanị aha ha dị iche
Myiri na-eji okwu dịka 'dịka' ma ọ bụ 'ka' iji tụnyere ihe abụọ, ebe mbụrụ na-ekwu na ihe otu bụ ihe ọzọ kpọmkwem na-enweghị njikọ dị otú ahụ
Myiri adịghị eji njikọ ọ bụla
questions.explanation: Myiri na-eji okwu njikọ dịka 'dịka' ma ọ bụ 'ka' iji mee ntụnyere doro anya, ebe mbụrụ na-akọwa ihe otu bụ ihe ọzọ na-enweghị njikọ ntụnyere ahụ.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: N'ahịrịokwu 'Anwụ na-amụ ọchị n'elu ugwu ahụ', kedu ụdị okwu okike (figure of speech) dị n'ime ya?
questions.explanation: Inye anwụ (ihe na-adịghị adị ndụ) omume mmadụ dịka 'ịmụ ọchị' bụ mmemmadụ (personification), nke na-enye ihe na-abụghị mmadụ àdị mmadụ.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe kpatara ilu ji dị oke mkpa n'okwu ọkà n'Igbo (na-ekwu na 'ilu bụ mmanụ e ji eri okwu')?
options: N'ihi na ilu na-enye okwu amamihe na ike ịkwado echiche n'ụzọ dị nro na nkenke, na-eme ka okwu ya dị ụtọ ma bụrụ nke akwadoro
N'ihi na ilu na-eme ka okwu dị mfe ịghọta na ime ka ọkà okwu dị arọ
N'ihi na ilu bụ naanị maka ndị okenye
N'ihi na ilu adịghị enwe nghọta ọ bụla
questions.explanation: Ilu na-eme ka okwu dị ụtọ, dịpụta iche, ma jiri amamihe kwado echiche onye na-ekwu okwu n'ụzọ dị nro.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ ihe okike (figure of speech) e ji akọwa ihe n'ụzọ mkpasu ọnụ karịrị ihe dị adị iji mesie echiche ike, dịka 'O riri nri karịrị ugwu'?
questions.explanation: Hyperbole (mkpasu okwu/imebiga okwu) bụ ikwu ihe n'ụzọ ka o buo ibu karịa eziokwu iji mee ka isi ihe ahụ pụta ìhè.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: N'ịtụle egwuregwu (drama) e dere ede n'Igbo, kedu ihe a na-akpọ okwu onye ọrụ na-ekwu naanị n'obi ya, nke ndị ọrụnnọgbu ndị ọzọ na-anụghị, iji mee ka ndị na-ege ntị mata echiche ya?
questions.explanation: 'Aside' bụ nkà e ji n'egwuregwu ebe onye ọrụ na-ekwu okwu ka ndị na-ekiri mara echiche ya nzuzo, ebe ndị ọrụnnọgbu ndị ọzọ n'ọdịnihu egwuregwu ahụ anụghị ya.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: N'agụmagụ edere ede, kedu ihe a na-akpọ ebe na oge ihe omume nke akụkọ na-eme?
questions.explanation: Setting (ọnọdụ akụkọ) na-egosipụta ebe na oge ihe omume dị n'akụkọ ma ọ bụ egwuregwu na-eme, dị iche na isi ihe ma ọ bụ ndị ọrụnnọgbu.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ onye ọrụnnọgbu dị mkpa karịsịa n'akụkọ, nke akụkọ ahụ na-adabere n'ihe ọ na-eme?
questions.explanation: Protagonist bụ onye ọrụnnọgbu isi nke akụkọ na-adabere na ya, ebe antagonist na-eguzogide ya.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ onye ọrụnnọgbu na-eguzogide onye ọrụnnọgbu isi n'akụkọ ma ọ bụ egwuregwu, na-ebutekarị esemokwu?
questions.explanation: Antagonist bụ onye ọrụnnọgbu na-eguzogide onye isi akụkọ ahụ (protagonist), na-ebute esemokwu na-akwalite akụkọ ahụ.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: N'ọmụmụ uri (poetry) Igbo, kedu ihe a na-akpọ ahịrịokwu abụọ ma ọ bụ karịa e dere ọnụ dịka otu akụkụ nke uri?
questions.explanation: Stanza (ngalaba uri) bụ nkewa nke uri nwere ahịrịokwu abụọ ma ọ bụ karịa jikọrọ ọnụ, dịka paragraph si dị n'edemede efu.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: N'ọmụmụ ederede uri Igbo, kedu ihe a na-akpọ mmegharị ọdịda ụda n'ọgwụgwụ ahịrịokwu uri abụọ ma ọ bụ karịa (dịka ha si daba n'otu ụda)?
questions.explanation: Rhyme (njikọta ụda ọgwụgwụ) bụ mgbe ọdịda ụda dị n'ọgwụgwụ ahịrịokwu uri abụọ ma ọ bụ karịa yiri ibe ha.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Ọ bụrụ na akwụkwọ akụkọ e nyere ụmụ akwụkwọ ịmụ maka ule JAMB Igbo na-elebara anya n'esemokwu dị n'etiti ọdịnala na ọzụzụ ọhụrụ (modernity), kedu ihe a na-akpọ echiche isi a na-akọwa n'ime akwụkwọ ahụ?
questions.explanation: Esemokwu dị n'etiti ọdịnala na ọzụzụ ọhụrụ ga-abụ isi ihe (theme) nke akwụkwọ ahụ na-akọwapụta, bụ isi echiche onye edemede na-akọ.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: N'egwuregwu (drama) Igbo e dere ede, kedu ihe a na-akpọ okwu onye edemede si nye ndị ọrụ ihe ha ga-eme n'ọnọdụ nnọọ (stage directions)?
questions.explanation: Stage directions bụ ntụziaka onye edemede na-enye banyere otu ndị ọrụnnọgbu ga-esi eme ihe, ebe ha ga-anọ, ma ọ bụ otu ha ga-esi kwuo okwu.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ọdịiche dị n'etiti mmemmadụ (personification) na 'mmadụ ka o si dị' (character portrayal) n'nyocha agụmagụ?
options: Character portrayal bụ naanị maka anụmanụ
Mmemmadụ bụ inye ihe na-abụghị mmadụ omume mmadụ, ebe character portrayal bụ otu e si akọwapụta àdị ndị ọrụnnọgbu bụ mmadụ n'akụkọ
Mmemmadụ bụ naanị maka ndị ọrụnnọgbu bụ mmadụ
questions.explanation: Mmemmadụ bụ ihe okike okwu (na-enye ihe na-adịghị ndụ omume mmadụ), ebe character portrayal bụ nyocha nke otú a kọwara ndị ọrụnnọgbu bụ mmadụ n'ime akụkọ.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ akụkọ ọdịnala e ji egosi ntule ndụ nke onye kpebiri ime ihe ọjọọ n'agbanyeghị ịdọ aka na ntị (dịka a hụkarị n'ọtụtụ ifo Igbo)?
options: Isi ihe (theme) nke ntaramahụhụ maka ajọ omume
questions.explanation: Ọtụtụ ifo Igbo na-egosipụta isi ihe nke ntaramahụhụ maka ime ihe ọjọọ ka a na-adọ aka na ntị megide ya, dị ka nkuzi omume ọma.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: N'ịtụle abụ ọdịnala Igbo, kedu ihe a na-akpọ akụkụ nke abụ a na-akpọghachi ugboro ugboro (dịka ndabere abụ), na-enyere aka ime ka ndị na-ege ntị soro bụọ?
questions.explanation: Refrain/chorus (nkwụghachi) bụ akụkụ abụ a na-akpọghachi ugboro ugboro, na-enyere aka ime ka ndị na-ege ntị mata ma soro bụọ abụ ahụ.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe kpatara ndị nkuzi ji akwado ka a ghara ịkọwa akụkọ n'usoro Igbo (translate) gaa n'asụsụ Bekee mgbe a na-amụ akwụkwọ akụkọ e dere ede n'Igbo?
options: N'ihi na ọtụtụ echiche na mma nke asụsụ Igbo (dịka ilu, mbụrụ, na ụtọ olu) nwere ike ifunahụ ma a tụgharịa ya n'asụsụ ọzọ
N'ihi na ọ dị mfe karịa
N'ihi na JAMB achọghị ka ụmụ akwụkwọ ghọta akụkọ ahụ
N'ihi na Bekee bụ asụsụ kachasị mma
questions.explanation: Ịtụgharị akwụkwọ akụkọ Igbo n'asụsụ ọzọ nwere ike ime ka echiche, ilu, na mma asụsụ (nuances) fu efu, ya mere a na-akwado ịmụ ya n'asụsụ mbụ e dere ya.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: N'ọmụmụ akụkọ (prose), kedu ihe a na-akpọ onye na-akọ akụkọ ahụ, ma ọ bụ onye olu na-akpọ akụkọ ahụ nye ndị na-agụ ya?
questions.explanation: Narrator (onye edemede) bụ olu na-akọ akụkọ ahụ nye ndị na-agụ ya, nwere ike ịbụ onye ọrụnnọgbu n'akụkọ ahụ ma ọ bụ onye na-elekwasị anya n'èzí.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ọdịiche dị n'etiti agwụgwa (riddle) na mbem (chant) dịka ụdị agụmagụ ọnụ Igbo?
options: Agwụgwa bụ ajụjụ ọkịkọ e ji anwale amamihe onye ọzọ, ebe mbem bụ akụkụ e ji arụ ọrụ site n'olu n'oge mmemme ma ọ bụ akwamozu
Mbem bụ ajụjụ ọkịkọ, ebe agwụgwa bụ olu
Agwụgwa bụ naanị maka ndị okenye
questions.explanation: Agwụgwa bụ egwuregwu ajụjụ-na-azịza e ji anwale uche na amamihe, ebe mbem bụ ederede olu a na-eji n'ememme ma ọ bụ akwamozu.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: N'ilu Igbo 'Aka aja aja na-arịa nri ọka aja aja', kedu isi echiche ilu a na-akọwa?
options: Na ịrụsi ọrụ ike (ọ bụ ezie na o nwere nsogbu) na-eweta uru na nri
Na ọka bụ nri kachasị mma
questions.explanation: Ilu a na-akụziri na onye rụsiri ọrụ ike, ọ bụ ezie na aka ya ga-adị ọjọọ (aja aja), ga-erite uru n'ọrụ ya.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ usoro e si egosipụta echiche onye edemede site n'iji ọdịdị ihe (dịka anụmanụ n'akụkọ ifo) kama ikwupụta ya n'ụzọ doro anya (symbolism)?
questions.explanation: Symbolism bụ ojiji ihe, dịka anụmanụ ma ọ bụ ihe ndị ọzọ, iji nọchite anya echiche dị omimi karịa nkọwa doro anya.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: N'ilu 'Onye ajụjụ anaghị efu ụzọ', kedu isi echiche a na-akọwa?
options: Naanị ndị amamihe kwesịrị ịjụ ajụjụ
Ịjụ ajụjụ mgbe ị na-amaghị ụzọ na-enye gị ohere ịchọta ihe ị na-achọ ma zere ndagharị
questions.explanation: Ilu a na-akụziri na ịjụ ajụjụ mgbe a na-amaghị ihe bụ amamihe na-enyere mmadụ aka izere ndagharị ma chọta ụzọ ziri ezi.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ ụdị agụmagụ ọnụ metụtara ndụmọdụ na amamihe na-agafeghị ọdịnihu, nke a na-eji akụzi ụmụaka omume ọma n'ụzọ dị nkenke, na-adịghị arụ ọtụtụ ahịrịokwu dịka ilu?
questions.explanation: Ilu na mbụrụ nkenke bụ ndụmọdụ amamihe dị mkpirikpi (ọ bụghị ogologo akụkọ) e ji akụziri ụmụaka na ndị ọzọ omume ọma.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: N'ọmụmụ akwụkwọ akụkọ e dere ede n'Igbo, gịnị ka a na-akpọ nkọwapụta zuru ezu banyere ọnọdụ mmekọrịta dị n'etiti ndị ọrụnnọgbu dị iche iche n'akụkọ ahụ?
questions.explanation: Mmekọrịta dị n'etiti ndị ọrụnnọgbu na-egosipụta otú ha si emetụta ibe ha n'ime akụkọ, na-akwalite ọganihu nke plot.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ ekele ọdịnala Igbo a na-enyekarị onye rụsiri ọrụ ike n'ubi ma ọ bụ n'ọrụ aka, dịka mgbe a hụrụ ya n'ọrụ?
options: Ndeewo/Jisie ike (greeting for one at work)
questions.explanation: 'Ndeewo' ma ọ bụ 'jisie ike' bụ ekele ọdịnala e ji akwanyere onye na-arụ ọrụ ùgwù, dị iche na ekele ụtụtụ ma ọ bụ nke ọzọ n'ọdịnala Igbo.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: N'ọdịnala Igbo, kedu ihe a na-akpọ nkwụsị nke alụmdi na nwunye mgbe nsogbu dị ukwuu adịghị ekwe ka ọ gaa n'ihu?
questions.explanation: Ịgba alụkwaghịm bụ usoro ọdịnala e ji akwụsị alụmdi na nwunye n'obodo Igbo mgbe esemokwu adịghị ekwe ka mmekọrịta ahụ gaa n'ihu.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ oge nlekọta na nkwado nwaanyị mụrụ nwa na-anata n'ọdịnala Igbo, nke gụnyere nne ya ma ọ bụ nwanne ya nwaanyị ịbịa nyere ya aka?
questions.explanation: Ọmụgwọ bụ oge ọdịnala e ji elekọta nwaanyị mụrụ nwa ọhụrụ na nwa ya, nke a na-akwadokarị site n'aka nne ya ma ọ bụ ndị ikwu nwanyị ndị ọzọ.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe kpatara ọmụgwọ ji dị mkpa n'ọdịnala Igbo maka nwaanyị dị ime ọhụrụ na nwa ya?
options: Ọ bụ naanị maka mmemme aṅụrị
Ọ dịghị mkpa ọ bụla n'ime ya
Ọ na-enye nwaanyị ohere izu ike, nweta nri na nlekọta kwesịrị ekwesị, na ịmụta otu e si elekọta nwa ọhụrụ
questions.explanation: Ọmụgwọ na-enye nne ọhụrụ ohere izu ike, nweta nri na nlekọta dị mma, yana nkuzi maka ilekọta nwa ọhụrụ, bụ akụkụ dị mkpa n'ime nlekọta ahụike ọdịnala.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ọkwa a na-akpọ ndị a na-ahọpụta ka ha bụrụ ndụmọdụ ma nyere eze ma ọ bụ obi aka n'ọchịchị obodo Igbo?
questions.explanation: Ndị Ichie bụ ndị nnukwu ọkwa n'obodo na-eguzo dịka ndụmọdụ na ndị nkwado eze ma ọ bụ obi n'ọchịchị obodo Igbo.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: N'usoro ọchịchị obodo Igbo ochie (tupu ọchịchị ndị ọcha), kedu ụdị nhazi ọchịchị a na-akpọkarị nke a na-eji ndị amala/okenye chịa obodo n'ебere enweghị otu eze n'isi (ọ bụghị monarchical)?
options: Ọchịchị eze n'isi (centralised monarchy) kwa mgbe
questions.explanation: Ọtụtụ obodo Igbo, karịsịa n'akụkụ ọwụwa anyanwụ, jiri usoro ọchịchị acephalous (enweghị otu onye eze n'isi), ebe ndị okenye/amala na-esonyere onwe ha kpebie ihe metụtara obodo.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe kpatara ọtụtụ obodo Igbo ochie ejighị eze n'otu onye dịka isi ọchịchị, dị ka a hụrụ n'ọtụtụ ala Yoruba?
options: N'ihi na ha na-ekwenye n'ịkekọrịta ike n'etiti ndị okenye, ndị Ichie, na otu ndị inyom (dịka Iyom) kama ịtinye ike n'aka otu onye
N'ihi na ha amaghị otu e si eme eze
N'ihi na ndị Bekee machibidoro ha
N'ihi na obodo Igbo dị ntakịrị
questions.explanation: Usoro ọchịchị Igbo ochie na-egosipụta nkwụkọrịta ike n'etiti otu ndị dị iche iche (ndị okenye, ndị Ichie, ndị Ọzọ, na ndị inyom) kama ịtinye ike niile n'aka otu onye.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ mmemme e ji egosipụta ọtụtụ Ọzọ dị iche iche, dịka a na-akpọ n'ụfọdụ obodo Igbo 'ọzọ Nri' ma ọ bụ 'ọzọ Awka', banyere otú ha si dị iche site n'obodo ruo n'obodo?
options: Na echichi/ọkwa ndị dịka Ọzọ nwere nhazi na aha dị iche site n'otu obodo Igbo gaa n'ọzọ, ọ bụghị otu usoro kpamkpam n'ala Igbo niile
Na ọzọ bụ otu ihe kpamkpam n'ebe niile n'Igbo
Na ọ dịghị ọzọ dị n'Igbo
Na ọzọ bụ naanị maka ndị inyom
questions.explanation: Echichi Ọzọ nwere nhazi, usoro, na aha dị iche iche site n'otu obodo Igbo gaa n'ibe ya, na-egosipụta ọtụtụ ọdịnala n'ime otu obodo Igbo n'ozuzu ya.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ọkwa a na-enye nwoke ketara ọkwa ọ bụla mgbe ọ nwụrụ, gụnyere ala na akụ ọ ga-ahapụ, dịka ọdịnala ikpekazi ihe nketa Igbo si dị?
questions.explanation: N'ọdịnala ikpekazi ihe nketa Igbo, ọkpara (nwa nwoke bu ụzọ amụ) na-arụkarị ọrụ dị mkpa n'ikekọrịta ihe nketa na ndozi ezinụlọ mgbe nna ha nwụrụ.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: N'ọdịnala Iwa Ji (New Yam Festival), kedu onye na-arụkarị ọrụ mbụ ibipụta ma rie ji ọhụrụ tupu ndị ọzọ n'obodo emerịrị ya?
options: Eze ma ọ bụ onye kachasị okenye n'obodo
questions.explanation: Eze ma ọ bụ onye kachasị okenye n'obodo na-arụkarị ọrụ mbụ isetịpụ ma rie ji ọhụrụ n'ememme Iwa Ji tupu a fee ndị ọzọ n'obodo ohere iri ya.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe kpatara ejighị eri ji ọhụrụ n'ụlọ tupu emume Iwa Ji emechaa n'ọtụtụ obodo Igbo?
options: N'ihi na ji ọhụrụ na-adịghị ọma iri
N'ihi na ọ bụ iwu gọọmentị
N'ihi na ndị okenye achọghị ka a rie ji
N'ihi na ọ bụ iwu ọdịnala igosi nkwanye ùgwù nye chi na ndị nna nna ha maka owuwe ihe ubi, tupu obodo emerịrị ọha ohere iri ya
questions.explanation: Ndozi a bụ maka ikwanyere chi na nna nna ha ùgwù na ekele maka owuwe ihe ubi tupu ọha na eze emerie ohere iri ji ọhụrụ ahụ.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ mkpọtụ ọha na eze (traditional council/assembly) na-eme ka o kwe ka ekpebi ihe ndị metụtara obodo Igbo n'ozuzu ya?
questions.explanation: Nzukọ ọha bụ mgbakọ ọha na eze, ndị Ichie, na ndị okenye e ji ekpebi ihe ndị dị mkpa metụtara obodo Igbo n'ozuzu ya.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ ekele Igbo a na-enyekarị onye ọbịa mgbe o bịara n'ụlọ mmadụ?
questions.explanation: 'Nnọọ' bụ ekele Igbo a na-enyekarị onye ọbịa iji nabata ya n'ụlọ ma ọ bụ obodo.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ ekele a na-enye mmadụ mgbe o mere ihe ọma ma ọ bụ mgbe a na-ekele ya maka ọrụ ọ rụchara?
questions.explanation: 'Daalụ' bụ okwu ekele e ji ekele mmadụ ma ọ bụ nyere ya otuto maka ihe ọma o mere.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: N'ọdịnala ime ọmụgwọ, kedu ọrụ kachasị dị mkpa nne nwaanyị mụrụ nwa na-arụ?
options: Ịga ọrụ ozugbo iji chọta ego
Ilekọta nwaanyị mụrụ nwa na nwa ya ọhụrụ, na-enyekwa ha nri na nlekọta ahụike
questions.explanation: N'ọdịnala ọmụgwọ, nne nwaanyị mụrụ nwa (ma ọ bụ onye nwanyị ọzọ n'ezinụlọ) na-abịa ilekọta nwa ọhụrụ ahụ na nne ya, na-enye ha nri na nkwado kwesịrị ekwesị.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ omenala e ji egosi na nwata aghọọla nwoke zuru oke, nke ụfọdụ mpaghara Igbo na-eme site n'ibi ugwu tupu nwa etoo?
options: Ntaramahụhụ ntozu (rite of passage) metụtara ibi ugwu
questions.explanation: Ibi ugwu (male circumcision) bụ otu n'ime ntaramahụhụ ntozu (rite of passage) e mekarị n'oge nwata bụ nwa ọhụrụ n'ọtụtụ obodo Igbo.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ nhazi ọha mmadụ dị n'otu afọ ọmụmụ, nke na-arụkọ ọrụ ọnụ maka mmepe obodo Igbo?
questions.explanation: Ọgbọ bụ nhazi ndị amụrụ n'otu oge (age-grade) na-arụkọ ọrụ ọnụ dịka ntụlite, ọrụ mmepe, na nchekwa n'obodo Igbo.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu uru ọgbọ (age-grade system) na-abara obodo Igbo n'usoro mmepe na nchekwa?
options: Ọ dịghị uru ọ bụla dị na ya
Ọ na-eme ka ụmụ okorobịa na ụmụ agbọghọ jikọọ aka rụọ ọrụ mmepe, chekwaa udo, ma dozie esemokwu obere n'obodo
questions.explanation: Ọgbọ na-eme ka ndị otu ọgbọ jikọọ aka n'ọrụ mmepe obodo, nchekwa udo, na ndozi esemokwu obere, na-eweta nkwụkọrịta n'etiti ndị obodo.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ ekele Igbo e ji akwado onye na-aga njem ka njem ya gaa nke ọma?
questions.explanation: 'Ije ọma' bụ ekele Igbo e ji akwado onye na-apụ njem, na-arịọ ka njem ya gaa nke ọma.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ ekwentị ọdịnala nke a na-eji akpọkọta ndị obodo n'oge ihe mberede, dịka ekwe ma ọ bụ ọdụ?
questions.explanation: Ngwa dịka ekwe na ọdụ e ji akpọ ọkụ, bụ ngwa nkwụkọrịta ọdịnala e ji akpọkọta ndị obodo n'oge ihe mberede ma ọ bụ mgbe a na-akpọ nzukọ.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ ekele Igbo a na-enye onye rịara ọrịa ma ọ bụ na-enwe nsogbu ahụike?
options: Ka ị dị mma (get well soon)
questions.explanation: 'Ka ị dị mma' bụ ekele e ji egosi ọchichọ ka onye na-arịa ọrịa dịghachi mma ozugbo.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: N'ọdịnala Igbo, kedu ihe na-akwadokarị usoro ikpekazi ihe nketa (inheritance) n'ọtụtụ mpaghara?
options: Naanị ụmụ nwaanyị na-enweta ihe nketa niile
Naanị ụmụ nwoke ka a na-enyekarị ohere iketa ala na akụ nna, dịka ọdịnala ochie si dị n'ọtụtụ mpaghara
A na-akụzu ihe nketa niile n'aka gọọmentị
Ọ dịghị iwu ọ bụla metụtara ihe nketa n'Igbo
questions.explanation: N'ọdịnala ochie Igbo n'ọtụtụ mpaghara, ụmụ nwoke, karịsịa ọkpara, na-enyekarị ohere iketa ala na akụ nna ha, ọ bụ ezie na iwu na omume ndị a na-agbanwe n'oge a.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ obodo/ala eze na-achị dịka Igwe ma ọ bụ Obi n'akụkụ ụfọdụ Igbo?
questions.explanation: Obodo ụfọdụ n'Igbo, karịsịa n'akụkụ ọdịda anyanwụ (dịka Onitsha, Aboh), nwere usoro ọchịchị eze/obi, dị iche na obodo acephalous ndị ọzọ.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: N'usoro alụmdi na nwunye ọdịnala Igbo, kedu isi ihe na-abụkarị mbụ tupu ị bido mkparịta ụka banyere ịkwụ ụgwọ ọlụlụ?
options: Ịkwụ ụgwọ ozugbo n'enweghị mkparịta ụka
Ime ememme naanị n'enweghị ndozi ọ bụla
Ịchọpụta ma ezinụlọ nwoke na nke nwaanyị nwere njikọ ọbara (dịka ha bụghị ikwu na ibe)
questions.explanation: Tupu alụmdi na nwunye aga n'ihu, a na-elebakarị anya hụ na ezinụlọ abụọ ahụ enweghị njikọ ọbara chiri ma ọ bụ mmekọrịta megidere omenala.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ mkpọtụ mmemme e ji efe chi na ndị mmụọ ekele n'ọtụtụ obodo Igbo, dị iche na ememme Iwa Ji?
questions.explanation: N'ọtụtụ obodo Igbo, e nwere ememme dị iche iche e ji efe chi na mmụọ dị iche na Iwa Ji, na-egosipụta ọtụtụ ọdịnala okpukpe Igbo.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ọdịiche dị n'etiti nkuzi Ahịajiọkụ na nzukọ dịka Ọhanaeze Ndigbo n'ihe gbasara ọrụ ha na-arụ?
options: Ọhanaeze Ndigbo bụ naanị maka mmụta asụsụ
Ahịajiọkụ Lecture bụ nzukọ ndọrọ ndọrọ ọchịchị
Ahịajiọkụ Lecture bụ nkuzi/mmụta a na-eme kwa afọ metụtara ọdịnala na asụsụ Igbo, ebe Ọhanaeze Ndigbo bụ nzukọ na-anọchite anya ọdịmma politiki na ọha ndị Igbo n'ozuzu ya
questions.explanation: Ahịajiọkụ Lecture bụ ọzụzụ mmụta akwụkwọ e ji akwalite ọmụmụ omenala na asụsụ Igbo, ebe Ọhanaeze Ndigbo bụ otu socio-cultural na-anọchite anya ọdịmma ọha Igbo n'ozuzu ya.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe kacha pụta ìhè metụtara mgbanwe na-adaba n'usoro ịgụ aha n'oge a n'obodo Igbo, dịka a tụnyere ya na ọdịnala ochie?
options: Ọ dịghị mgbanwe ọ bụla mere
Ọtụtụ ndị Igbo na-agbakwunye aha Kraịst (Christian names) na aha ọdịnala Igbo n'oge ịgụ aha ugbu a
A kwụsịrị ime ịgụ aha kpamkpam
A na-eme ya naanị n'ụlọ ọrụ gọọmentị
questions.explanation: N'oge a, ọtụtụ ndị Igbo na-ejikọta aha Kraịst na aha ọdịnala Igbo n'oge ịgụ aha, na-egosipụta mmekọrịta dị n'etiti okpukpe ọdịnala na nke ọhụrụ.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ ọrụ gọọmentị obodo/steeti na-arụ n'ịkwado mmụta na mgbasa ozi metụtara asụsụ na omenala Igbo n'oge a?
options: Ọ dịghị ọrụ ọ bụla ha na-arụ
Ha na-akwado nkwalite site n'iwu na atụmatụ dịka ịme ka asụsụ Igbo bụrụ isi asụsụ a na-akụzi n'ụlọ akwụkwọ elu
Ha na-arụkarị ọrụ metụtara mba ofesi naanị
questions.explanation: Ọtụtụ gọọmentị steeti n'ala Igbo na-akwado atụmatụ na iwu dịka mkpebi ime ka asụsụ Igbo bụrụ otu n'ime asụsụ a na-akụzi n'ụlọ akwụkwọ, iji kwalite mmụta ya.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe kpatara ọ dị mkpa ka ụmụ akwụkwọ na-amụ Igbo maara maka ọrụ Igbo Studies Association (ISA) na nzukọ ndị ọkà mmụta ndị ọzọ?
options: N'ihi na ha nwere ike ijide ọkwa n'ime ha ozugbo
N'ihi na ọ bụ akụkụ iwu gọọmentị
N'ihi na ha na-egosi na nnyocha na mmụta metụtara Igbo ka na-aga n'ihu n'akwụkwọ elu, na-akwalite ọdịnihu asụsụ na omenala Igbo
N'ihi na ọ bụghị ihe ọ bụla metụtara ule JAMB
questions.explanation: Ịmara maka ISA na nzukọ ndị ọkà mmụta ndị ọzọ na-egosi ụmụ akwụkwọ na nnyocha akwụkwọ elu ka na-akwalite ma na-echekwa ọdịnihu asụsụ na omenala Igbo.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe a na-akpọ nkwụsị ndị mmadụ na-eme n'oge Iwa Ji iji gosi ekele nye chi ala na chi mmiri maka nchekwa ha n'oge ọrụ ubi gara aga?
options: Ekpere na ịgọ chi ekele (thanksgiving prayers/rites)
questions.explanation: Ememme Iwa Ji na-agụnye ekpere na ịgọ chi ekele maka nchekwa na inyeaka chi ala na chi mmiri n'oge ọrụ ubi gara aga.

questions.subject: Igbo
questions.text: Kedu ihe kpatara ọ dị mkpa ka ụmụ akwụkwọ na-amụ Igbo ghọta mmekọrịta dị n'etiti ọdịnala na omenala Igbo na okpukpe Kraịst n'oge a?
options: N'ihi na ọ dịghị mmekọrịta ọ bụla dị n'etiti ha
N'ihi na nghọta banyere otú omenala Igbo si adaba (ma ọ bụ agbanwe) n'agbanyeghị okpukpe Kraịst na-enyere aka nyocha ọdịnihu ọdịnala Igbo
N'ihi na ha bụ otu okpukpe kpamkpam
N'ihi na iwu machibidoro ọmụmụ ọdịnala
